source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1

        delta = marker - hi - 1 if marker > hi else marker - lo + 1
        for r,c in pts: out[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in pts: out[r + delta][c] = grid[r][c]
        far = lo + delta - 1 if marker > hi else hi + delta + 1
